subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery and permission binding?
rationale: The change is additive, but it freezes plugin-author API surface and influences a host-permission discovery path around Accessibility and Screen Recording, so automation should not decide the contract semantics alone.

options.title: Review linked PR and confirm contract
options.body: Regenerate any stale docs artifacts, confirm the fields are discovery-only rather than authorization, and land the linked PR if owners agree with the public API shape.

options.title: Revise the manifest shape first
options.body: Rename, narrow, or split the provider metadata before release if the platform or permission semantics are not stable enough.

options.title: Pause the public contract
options.body: Keep the issue open and the linked PR draft until the macOS host binding design is firmer.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR and confirm contract
recommendation.body: Regenerate any stale docs artifacts, confirm the fields are discovery-only rather than authorization, and land the linked PR if owners agree with the public API shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed overlap across plugin manifest metadata, docs, and Computer Use setup surfaces.
